name: All Hands
idea: A three-quarter azure octopus with a taped parcel cupped in each reaching arm and its eyes on the next drop: one courier handling many deliveries at once, in every direction.
why: "The blue octopus juggling boxes" is a picture people can retell after a single glance, and no courier in the region owns an octopus.
risks: It is busier than a pictogram, so below about 24 px it reduces to a blue shape with white specks, and the cartoon octopus (in a crowded azure family near Telegram and Docker blue) may feel too playful for conservative B2B clients.
